feeds.title: Zakat Blog
feeds.description: Articles on humanitarian aid and human stories by Zakat. UNHCR's Refugee Zakat Fund is a trusted, compliant and effective distributor. Majority of the world's 26 million refugees fall under at least 4 of the 8 Zakat categories. Over 80% of the world's refugee population and nearly all the world's internally displaced people are hosted in low to middle-income countries, many of which have weaker health and water systems.

feeds.title: World Vision
feeds.description: Find the latest news, inspiring stories, updates, and personal views about World Vision's work around the world. World Vision is a Christian humanitarian organization dedicated to working with children, families, and their communities worldwide to reach their full potential by tackling the causes of poverty and injustice.

feeds.title: Unto Blog
feeds.description: Read stories and articles on humanitarian aid. Unto help you express the kindness of Jesus to people living in the toughest places on earth by relieving suffering, restoring dignity, and revealing hope.

feeds.title: Creating Hope in Conflict
feeds.description: Read news and blog about Humanitarian Grand Challenge.Our goal is to find and accelerate life-saving or life-improving innovations to help the most vulnerable and hardest-to-reach people impacted by humanitarian crises caused by conflict.

feeds.title: HUMANITARIAN DISARMAMENT
feeds.description: Articles, resources and events on humanitarian aid by Humanitarian Disarmament. Over the past two decades, humanitarian disarmament has become a highly effective and firmly established means of dealing with the adverse impacts of arms. This people-centered approach to disarmament focuses on preventing and remediating human suffering and environmental harm, rather than advancing national security.

feeds.title: Humanitarian Advisory Group Blog
feeds.description: Articles, insights, news and events on humanitarian aid. As an ethically driven business, they combine humanitarian passion with entrepreneurial agility to think and do things differently.

feeds.title: Social Science in Humanitarian Action Platform
feeds.description: Read blogs, news & events from Social Science in Humanitarian Action Platform. SSHAP is a programme of work focusing on the social dimensions of emergency responses. They work on emergencies that relate to health, conflict, or the environment.

feeds.title: Himalayan Institute Blog
feeds.description: Read about our partnership with rural communities to provide health services, public libraries, and sustainable employment opportunities at Himalayan Institute. Our projects serve impoverished rural areas, regenerating the environment and empowering communities with the knowledge and tools needed for lasting social transformation.

feeds.title: The Global Humanitarian
feeds.description: Covers articles for those looking to enter the humanitarian aid and development field. Created by an aid worker for aid workers.

feeds.title: Humanitarian Hub

feeds.title: PRIO Blogs » Humanitarianism
feeds.description: Articles on conflicts, migration, law and ethics by PRIO. The Peace Research Institute Oslo (PRIO) conducts research on the conditions for peaceful relations between states, groups, and people. Researchers at PRIO seek to understand the processes that bring societies together or split them apart.

feeds.title: Humanitarian Health Ethics

The humanitarian health ethics research group is a multidisciplinary team of researchers and practitioners collaborating together since 2009 with the aim of helping to clarify the ethical issues that are present in humanitarian healthcare practice.

feeds.title: Norwegian Centre for Humanitarian Studies
feeds.description: Read about promoting research on humanitarian issues at Norwegian Center. Norwegian governmental and non-governmental actors are important actors on the humanitarian stage, and humanitarian principles are central to overall Norwegian foreign policy. Whether caused by violent conflicts or natural disasters, humanitarian crises raise fundamental questions about ethics, law, sovereignty, and foreign policy.

feeds.title: CIHA Blog
feeds.description: Read about news, events and resources on charity, global health democracy and Hmanitarian aid. The Critical Investigations into Humanitarianism in Africa (CIHA) Blog seeks to transform the phenomenon of aid to Africa into egalitarian and respectful relationships that challenge unequal power relations, paternalism and victimization.

feeds.title: Humanitarianism & Human Rights

At present, many international scholars here at the Leibniz Institute of European History (IEG), conduct research on their own which extends the sources and trajectories of humanitarian norms and human rights.

feeds.title: United Nations Foundation Blog
feeds.description: Read about ideas, and resources connecting people with the United Nations to solve global problems. The UN Foundation, a public charity, was created in 1998 with entrepreneur and philanthropist Ted Turner's historic $1 billion gifts to support UN causes.

feeds.title: HI

feeds.title: European Commission

feeds.title: Elrha
